reason: The free first visit means I can try it with no risk, and I'm home with the kids all week and always need somewhere indoors. I'd likely do the free visit and maybe one paid drop-in, but I wouldn't sign up for a monthly membership until I knew we'd really go.
objection: $45 a month is a lot when library storytime and the parks are free. I'd only pay if my kids actually asked to go back, and I'd probably end up going less than I plan to.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper per-visit price or a membership under $30 that I could count on to pay for itself after about 3 visits.
